One day. 150+ leaders. One clear focus: turning AI into results.

Conclusion Connect brings together decision-makers, digital leaders, and top technology partners for a curated day of strategic exchange, real-world insights, and high-quality networking. If you're serious about making AI work for your business - this is where you need to be.
📍 Van der Valk Hotel Düsseldorf
📅 September 17, 2026
Home
Conclusion Connect

AI is changing how organizations operate, engage with customers, and make decisions. Conclusion Connect provides a forum to discuss practical experiences, exchange perspectives, and learn from organizations that are already putting AI into practice.
Real-world AI applications: learn from organizations that have successfully scaled AI across operations, customer engagement, and digital experiences
